    Summands far from a set #

    Let U be a sincere indecomposable module of a directed algebra and H a nonempty set of points. On the convex set E of points with no path to or from H, the truncation of U has a summand through every point v far from H, and that summand reaches near H (exists_far_summand). So its support is large. The size of balls in the underlying graph is controlled by card_layerF_le.
